dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: Guess I'll have to try a new prescription...

dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: I'm the physician in this area. Come find me anytime if you're feeling unwell.

dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: You're young and full of fire, and ironically, that makes you more susceptible to illnesses in these mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you trying new prescriptions?

dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: There are no panaceas, so a good physician must find the right medicine to treat each patient's symptoms.

dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: If the illness is complex, then we'll have to dig deep to find the ultimate prescription.

dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: Well, all that assumes the physician has seen enough to be familiar with lots of different medicines, of course...

dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: To master the effects of different prescriptions, I have to keep trying and learn from my mistakes.

dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: Work out regularly, and keep a balanced diet.

dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: Heatiness is the root of all evil inside the body, and young people are especially prone to it, for their bodies are easily excited.

dialogues.speaker: Yiqing
dialogues.text: I have a few herbs to help quench the flames and vent the heat. Most effective when taken with herbal tea. Please help yourselves.
